title: Материальная культура чукчей
author: Владимир Германович Богораз
chapters: Основные труды В. Г. Богораза о чукчах
subtitle: Авторизованный перевод с английского

metadata_record_overrides.evidence: PDF 4 title and exact ISBN on PDF 5 match this catalog edition; catalog title is the romanization of the printed Russian title.
PDF 5 prints Наука, Главная редакция восточной литературы, Москва, 1991; catalog uses its romanization.

comments.metadata: Exact ISBN record OL1292845M credits V.G. Bogoraz, Russian language, 1991, and the same authorized translation. Its author authority uses Waldemar Bogoras; PDF 5 also identifies the English original by W. Bogoras. Reviewed transliteration aliases retain source Cyrillic metadata.
comments.notes: Short lower-left footer separator proposals were source-reviewed; a discarded marker/font-height prototype was insufficient. Current zones are based on separator evidence, with page-group note navigation.
comments.figure_review: Reviewed all 263 source thumbnails and figure-group sheets. Thin-tool illustration leaves consolidated to retain complete shafts and captions; PDF 152 includes a separately reviewed thin-tool group, PDF 234 retains the full illustrated leaf. Some complex side-wrapped prose remains inside source facsimiles.
comments.note_continuation: Source-reviewed PDF 8 bottom bibliographic note continues with l’homme. Paris… on PDF 9; page-group apparatus retained together.
comments.figure_color: Source drawings and photographs are monochrome; grayscale native-pixel JPEG export without paper normalization. Original green cover retains RGB.
comments.mixed_ocr: Vision observations propose mixed rus+eng pages when an OCR line has at least 20 Latin letters and Latin letters form at least 30% of its letters. Reviewed resulting 31-page plan; these thresholds propose script choice, not text corrections.
